description: This file defines a base activity class 'SampleActivityBase' extending Android's FragmentActivity. It handles initialization of logging facilities during activity lifecycle events.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class providing common setup, especially logging initialization, for Android sample activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created, currently only calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity becomes visible; it also initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up custom logging by wrapping Android's log system and writes a 'Ready' log entry.
